item.title: Wythenshawe momentum builds with food hall plans
item.description: A dining destination is to be created within two vacant and one soon-to-be-vacant retail units on Hale Top as part of the ongoing regeneration of the civic centre. The post Wythenshawe momentum builds with food hall plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.description: Great British Energy – Nuclear has appointed the two global built environment consultancies to deliver a five-year environmental services programme, geared towards enabling the delivery of small modular reactors at the North Wales site. item.title: From Chandigarh to Cheshire: can Britain finally get new towns right?
item.description: What can a new town in Worcestershire learn from the Indian city of Chandigarh? And can the would-be planners of Adlington, Cheshire pick up a few tips from Paris? A new report from the town planners' institute certainly thinks so. The post From Chandigarh to Cheshire: can Britain finally get new towns right? appeared first on Place North West.
